result.answer_string: {"answer": "Logistic regression is a statistical model used for binary (or multinomial) classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to a particular class as a logistic (sigmoid) function of a linear combination of the input features. In other words, it estimates the log\u2011odds of the outcome as a linear function of the predictors. The model is typically fit by maximizing the likelihood of the observed data (maximum likelihood estimation). Logistic regression is widely used because it is simple, interpretable, and provides probabilistic outputs that can be thresholded for decision making. It can also be extended to handle more than two classes (multinomial logistic regression) or ordinal outcomes (ordinal logistic regression)."}
